registered: before looking at any returns (only the event count per year was looked at: 2021 1, 2022 2, 2023 36, 2024 17, 2025 114, 2026 196); reference v9.6 3.161 [2.775, 3.919, 2.576]
data: research_data/binance_pit funding files (funding_interval_hours per settlement), hourly closes; TradFi excluded
event: a settlement whose funding interval is shorter than the previous settlement's (Binance shortens the interval when funding sits at its cap), on a coin whose first bar is at least 30 days earlier
rule: side = -sign(sum of the funding rates of the last 3 settlements up to and including the event); enter at the next whole hour after the settlement, size 0.05, hold H days, cover for good when the close moves 30% against the entry close; gross cap 0.5; 10 bp per side; real funding; one position per coin (a new event on an open coin is ignored)
pass: added to v9.6 as its own sleeve; strict rule vs v9.6 (research reference; the live-timing reference is reported); with several passes the highest 2022-26 Sharpe
